sample_unit: evaluations (by 194 physicians across 42 real UTI cases)

links.outcome: Concordance of AI antimicrobial recommendations with physicians and blinded expert preference in discordant cases
links.effect: First-choice concordance was 50.9% and general concordance 62.5%. ID specialists showed higher concordance than non-ID physicians (72.9% vs. 57.8% general). The panel preferred the CDSS in 90.5-93.2% of discordant cases.
links.quote: Among discordant evaluations, the external panel judged the CDSS recommendation to be preferable in 90.5-93.2% of cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the concordance between physician selections and a machine learning clinical decision support system (OneChoice) recommendations for UTI antibiotic selection using retrospective case vignettes, adjudicated by blinded experts.
